{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.06

|eff= local

|gr1= Event Handlers

|descr= Removes a UserAction event handler. For a list of available UserAction event handlers, see: [[Arma 3: Mission Event Handlers]].

|s1= [[removeUserActionEventHandler]] [keyName, event, index]

|p1= keyName: [[String]] - action key name; see [[inputAction/actions]]

|p2= event: [[String]] - event name - see [[Arma 3: Event Handlers#UserAction Event Handlers|UserAction Event Handlers]]. Can be one of:
* "Activate"
* "Deactivate"
* "Analog"

|p3= index: [[Number]] - index returned by [[addUserActionEventHandler]]

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>removeUserActionEventHandler ["Reload", "Activate", _reloadUAEH];</sqf>

|seealso= [[addUserActionEventHandler]] [[removeAllUserActionEventHandlers]] [[Arma 3: Event Handlers#UserAction Event Handlers|UserAction Event Handlers]]
}}
